item.title: Bryan Norcross: Development likely in the Atlantic and Pacific – Hawaii on alert
item.description: The system about a third of the way from Africa to the Caribbean shows some signs of organization. The National Hurricane Center has the odds in the high range that it will develop into at least a tropical depression somewhere in the red potential development area.

item.title: Bryan Norcross: Getting closer to tropical development in the Atlantic and a threat to Hawaii
item.description: The National Hurricane Center is identifying two areas to watch in the eastern tropical Atlantic, plus one far to the north. The interesting one is the right one in orange. It has a medium chance of developing into at least a tropical depression this week.
